(4) Notwithstanding the provisions of section 4(1)(b) of the Act—
(a) a person who is authorised by a written authority issued by the Secretary of State under and
for the purposes of this sub-paragraph and for the time being in force may, at the premises
specified in that authority and in compliance with any conditions so specified, supply or
offer to supply any drug specified in Schedule 3 or 4 to any person who may lawfully have
that drug in his possession;
(b) a person who is authorised under paragraph (1)(c ) may supply or offer to supply any drug
which he may, by virtue of being so authorised, lawfully produce to any person who may
lawfully have that drug in his possession.
